key_provisions_or_claims: Council to authorise EU signature of the CoE Framework Convention on AI, subject to later conclusion
Legal basis Article 114 in conjunction with Article 218(5) TFEU; EU-only agreement with exclusive competence
Convention to be implemented in the EU exclusively through the AI Act and other acquis
Convention excludes national security and defence; research limited; private-sector application optional via declaration
Requires remedies, risk and impact assessment, transparency, oversight mechanisms and consideration of bans or moratoria
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal for a Council Decision authorising the EU to sign the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI, Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law. The explanatory memorandum explains the Convention's scope, its consistency with the AI Act, the legal basis and the EU's exclusive competence.
annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Council Decision on the signing, on behalf of the European Union, of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence, Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Council Decision on the signing, on behalf of the European Union, of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence, Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law
